rows.label: tlk42400045_03_msg0001
rows.name: Toriri's new employer is Ion-chan, mo.

rows.label: tlk42400045_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I was so bored without work, sliding
down the waterway by the stairs to
Karam Ruins, when I got the offer, mo.

rows.label: tlk42400045_03_msg0003
rows.name:
The job of ticket-taker at
the Bajena Playhouse...
It's quite rewarding, mo!

rows.label: tlk42400045_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Ion-chan seems to be paying Toriri's
salary out of pocket money, so I feel
a little guilty, mo.
